quarantined.reason: The suite (fe3d50943, 2026-11-09) refuses to run unless MAKEFLAGS/CARGO_MAKEFLAGS/MFLAGS carry `--jobserver-auth=`, i.e. unless a maintained GNU make (>= 4.2) jobserver owns the process. This runner launches each suite directly, and this Mac's only make is GNU 3.81, which speaks `--jobserver-fds` only. The suite was qualified green under Trust's native_serial managed executor instead (reports/2026-11-10-python-resource-transport/green-1, green-2), so it has been red in this gate since it landed. The refusal is the suite's design, not a defect this lane may route around: running it without an owner proves nothing about the transport it tests.
quarantined.owner_action: Give the suite a caller that provides a maintained GNU jobserver owner (or teach this runner to launch it under one), then delete this row; the row fails as STALE the moment the suite passes here.
